Terrible experience
Jul 2026 • Friends
I am writing to share feedback about my recent dining experience at La Badiane in Hanoi. On 30.7.2026 at approximately 8pm, while we were having dinner, we saw a mouse in the dining area, which immediately made us feel distressed and uncomfortable.

Due to our fear and concern for hygiene, we chose to give up the dessert and a glass of dessert wine that we had already ordered, as we could no longer continue with our meal in good conscience. We politely requested a refund for those items or a discount to reflect the seriousness of the incident, but the restaurant refused, claiming that this was not their problem.

To make matters worse, the staff attitude was unhelpful and rude, which only deepened our disappointment and frustration.

After several rounds of discussion, they only agreed to deduct around 40K VND from our bill—an amount that does not even match the actual price of the desserts and wine we had to forgo.

I believe this matter warrants serious review. Overall I do not recommend this restaurant.

Beauty Over Substance
Jul 2025 • Solo
I tried the Le Dégustation fusion dinner set at La Badiane. The salmon gravlax started strong. Pink peppercorn gave it a sharp kick. The meal dropped off from there. The cold foie gras terrine lacked rich oils. Dense in texture, it missed the buttery melt. The cocoa bean sauce pairing felt disjointed. For the main, braising the Wagyu neck was an odd choice. The meat stayed tender, but the long cooking over-rendered the signature fat and left the muscle fibers dry. Service was attentive, and the courtyard was quiet. However, the kitchen sells a concept it cannot execute.

A little bit a France in Vietnam
Jan 2026 • Couples
By comparison to other ‘highly rated’ restaurants in Hanoi we found La Badiane outstanding.
The restaurant and ambience was lovely. The service was excellent and friendly. Also has a great well priced wine menu.
The food however was outstanding - we had a scallop and prawn ravioli to start but the star of the show was the pan roasted goose that was perfect. Followed by a chocolate based dessert that finished us off nicely!!
Superb value for money and cooking to the highest quality.
We had a fantastic evening.
